extracted.name: Strawberry Blue Cheese Salad
extracted.description: Fresh greens are tossed with strawberries, toasted pecans, and blue cheese. A lively dressing unites all the flavors into a springtime delight!
instruction_lines: Place the pecans in a skillet over medium heat. Tossing frequently, toast until lightly browned.
In a bowl, whisk together the raspberry vinegar, balsamic vinegar, and olive oil.
In a large bowl, mix the toasted pecans, greens, strawberries, blue cheese, and red onion. Toss with the vinegar and olive oil dressing mixture to serve.
